test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Many people may not find the rewards ______ with the time and effort required.
solution: The correct answer is **"commensurate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Commensurate"** means corresponding in size or degree; proportionate. (आकार, महत्व, योग्‍यता आदि के अनुरूप) • **Example**: *His boss informed him that his salary would be **commensurate**__ with his experience.* • The sentence implies that the rewards should be proportional to the time and effort required. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *Many people may not find the rewards __**commensurate**__ with the time and effort required.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - collude**: to conspire or work together secretly for illegal or dishonest purposes. (अवैध या बेईमान उद्देश्यों के लिए गुप्त रूप से षड्यंत्र करना या मिलकर काम करना) • **Option 2 - coffer**: a box or chest for holding valuables. (पैसे, गहने आदि बहुमूल्य वस्तुएँ रखने का एक बड़ा और मज़बूत बक्सा; तिजोरी, संदूक़) • **Option 4 - capable**: having the ability or skill to do something. (कुछ करने में सक्षम या समर्थ) 37:T5bc, The correct answer is **"Contribute."**
